test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

This cruise ship ______ in November and December.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**sails'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sails **mean **to travel by boat**.

 
 
• Example - ***Leo sails the world with his wife every year.***
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, This cruise ship sai
